Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model

Record Class HealthcareAiCompany

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.HealthcareAiCompany
Record Components:
companyId - UUID primary key
name - display name (e.g. "Tempus AI")
nameNormalized - lowercase, suffix-stripped name for dedup
domain - website domain (e.g. "tempus.com")
description - company description from Perplexity extraction
hqLocation - headquarters location (e.g. "Chicago, IL")
foundedYear - year founded (nullable if unknown)
sector - broad sector (e.g. "Healthcare AI")
subSector - specific focus (e.g. "clinical documentation")
fundingStage - latest funding stage (e.g. "Series C", "Public")
estimatedFunding - total funding as free-text (e.g. "$200M")
foundersJson - JSON array of founders: [{"name":"...","title":"..."}]
sourceUrls - Perplexity citation URLs from discovery
validated - whether cross-validation against curated lists passed
validationSources - URLs from validation calls (CB Insights, Rock Health)
discoveredAt - when first discovered by the pipeline
lastValidatedAt - most recent validation timestamp
public record HealthcareAiCompany(String companyId, String name, String nameNormalized, String domain, String description, String hqLocation, Integer foundedYear, String sector, String subSector, String fundingStage, String estimatedFunding, String foundersJson, List<String> sourceUrls, boolean validated, List<String> validationSources, Instant discoveredAt, Instant lastValidatedAt) extends Record
Immutable domain record representing an AI-in-healthcare company discovered and enriched via the Perplexity API pipeline.

Contains rich company intelligence fields including funding stage, estimated funding, founders, headquarters, and sector classification. Each company is deduplicated by normalized name and domain before insertion.

Source provenance is tracked via sourceUrls (discovery citations) and cross-validation status via validated and validationSources.
